metrics.label: Rules decision scenario acceptance
metrics.scope: Original-data and developer-authored synthetic scenarios. Excludes mock/replay Jev.
metrics.measures: Specified action, approval, precedent and evidence checks; not human-rated answer accuracy.

metrics.label: Ranking rule conformance
metrics.measures: Ordering obeys declared heuristic and preserves gates/provenance; not best-deal prediction.

metrics.label: Demo recommendation integrity
metrics.measures: Citations resolve, precedents belong to candidate records, account scope and proposal labels hold. Does not prove that every citation entails each claim.

metrics.label: Mock/replay Jev integration checks
metrics.measures: Fallback and policy integration behavior, not provider quality.

metrics.label: Historical paraphrases: rules
metrics.measures: Exact match to the developer-assigned obstacle label; classification only.

metrics.label: Historical paraphrases: live Jev
metrics.scope: Same messages and labels, historical run 2026-10-09T22:28:15.317184+00:00; no new provider call.
metrics.measures: Exact match for obstacle classification only, not whole-app accuracy.

limitations: Not an independent holdout. Development cases and synthetic labels may favor the implementation.
No benchmark-wide SalesTranscriptQA run and no comparable external accuracy score.
No measured sales uplift, time-to-close improvement, novice-user study or independent ranking ground truth.
